summary: The exact areas, projection chambers, radical expressions, support maxima, rational radical bounds, midpoint polygon area, and genericity computations all check. The projection-quantile implication is also mathematically true for the stated convex bodies, but the submitted proof omits the continuity/attainment fact needed for its strict quantile inequality, and its final a-fortiori exclusion invokes undefined downstream structures without any supplied implication to condition (3).
gaps: In (11), the definition of q_i alone gives s_i <= q_i from a cap area below m. The strict inequality s_i < q_i also requires q_i to belong to the superlevel set, equivalently continuity of q mapped to |A_0 intersect {lambda_i <= q}|. This is true here because lambda_i is nonzero and every level line has planar measure zero, but the proof neither states nor proves it.

The claimed a-fortiori exclusion of every rational convex extension satisfying three genuine lower crossings, the scalar completion interval, and support-clearance inequalities is not self-contained: those notions are undefined, and no accepted predecessor fact or argument establishes that such an extension supplies the K, t, and row conditions in (3).
repair_hints: Before (11), prove that the cap-area function is continuous, so the infimum q_i is attained with cap area at least m.
Define the downstream extension conditions and prove that three genuine lower crossings imply both inequalities and nonemptiness assertions in (3), or omit that unsupported application.
